composition: Use symmetrical framing with a single subject (character or object) occupying 40% to 50% of the center canvas.
For vertical layouts, divide into thirds: foreground elements in the bottom 30%, subject in the center 40%, background elements in the top 30%.
For horizontal layouts, use a 15% left-aligned logo/graphic balanced by a 60% wide text block on the right.
Place giant background text spanning 80% to 100% of the canvas width directly behind the mid-ground subject to create depth layers.
typographie: Use ultra-bold, condensed sans-serif in all-caps for primary titles, layered behind the subject's limbs or head but in front of the background.
Apply a two-tier hierarchy: primary title in a bold solid color or gradient, secondary technical details in a thin, wide-spaced sans-serif at the bottom.
Ensure text interacting with subjects uses a clean vector outline layer in front of the subject and a solid fill layer behind them.
lumiere: Implement strong, high-contrast rim lighting (white, cyan, or pink) on the subject's shoulders, hair, or outer edges.
Use vibrant ambient under-glow or corner spotlights (red, purple, or pink) to cast soft volumetric light cones over the scene.
For outdoor scenes, apply harsh midday sunlight with strong specular highlights on skin and metallic surfaces.
etalonnage: Apply a high-contrast, desaturated black base paired with a single vibrant accent color family: Deep Crimson (#8B0000), Neon Lime (#DFFF00), or Monochromatic Purple (#4A2E80).
For summer themes, use a highly saturated warm palette combining rich teals, coral reds (#FF5A5F), and golden hour tones.
effets: Overlay subtle floating dust particles, soft volumetric fog, and a dark circular vignette to focus attention on the center.
Integrate technical background elements like fine grid overlays, topographic vector lines, or halftone dot patterns.
logo: Place a small, stylized server logo in the top-right or bottom-left corner, and a tiny creator watermark centered at the absolute bottom edge.
interdits: Do not use low-resolution hand-painted or distressed textures on text layers.
Avoid repeating identical UI buttons or Discord links multiple times in a vertical layout.
Do not use flat, copy-pasted 2D assets (like cash or bullets) that lack matching 3D lighting and drop shadows.
Avoid dripping or melting liquid text effects on clean, luxury-themed resort backdrops.
